source: Hand-compiled from the sources named on each row; each row carries the date it was last checked
note: The visa rules are the UK government's reading of Egypt's rules for British passports. Rules for other passports can differ, so check your own country's travel advice.

rows.label: Visa on arrival
rows.detail: Sold at kiosks before the immigration counters at approved airports. Valid for up to 30 days.
rows.source: UK government travel advice: Egypt, entry requirements (updated 12 Nov 2026)

rows.label: Digital visa on arrival, Cairo airport only
rows.detail: Since 1 August 2026, from self-service machines or the Visa on Arrival portal, visaonarrival.gov.eg. The price includes a US$6 digital service fee.
rows.source: UK government travel advice: Egypt, entry requirements (updated 12 Nov 2026)

rows.label: e-Visa, before you fly
rows.value: US$30 single entry, US$65 multiple entry
rows.detail: Apply on the government portal, visa2egypt.gov.eg. The UK government says a tourist e-visa is valid for up to 3 months and can save time at the airport.
rows.source: ATTA: Egypt to raise single-entry visa fee to $33 from January 2027

rows.label: Flying into Sharm el-Sheikh for the Sinai resorts only
rows.value: Free entry stamp, up to 15 days
rows.detail: Covers Sharm el-Sheikh, Dahab, Nuweiba and Taba. To travel beyond those resorts, or to stay longer, you need a visa.
rows.source: UK government travel advice: Egypt, entry requirements (updated 12 Nov 2026)

rows.label: Visa agents in the arrivals hall
rows.detail: Agents often charge more than the US$30 fee. If one harasses you, report it to the tourist police in the terminal.
rows.source: UK government travel advice: Egypt, entry requirements (updated 12 Nov 2026)

rows.label: From 1 January 2027
rows.value: US$33, or US$39 at Cairo's digital kiosks
rows.detail: A Cabinet decision of 13 August 2026 raises the single-entry visa by US$3. When we checked, the e-Visa portal still showed the old price.
rows.source: ATTA: Egypt to raise single-entry visa fee to $33 from January 2027

rows.label: Egyptian pounds in or out of the country
rows.detail: There is no limit on foreign currency, but you must declare more than US$10,000 when you arrive.
rows.source: UK government travel advice: Egypt, entry requirements (updated 12 Nov 2026)

rows.label: Cards issued by Russian banks
rows.detail: Mir and UnionPay cards work in only a few places, and Russian cards are sometimes declined because of sanctions. Bring US dollars or euros in cash and change them in Egypt, at a bank or an exchange office.
rows.source: Sravni: Currency in Egypt (updated 2 Nov 2026, in Russian)

rows.label: Cities where Uber says it operates
rows.value: Cairo, Alexandria, Hurghada, the Canal Cities, Mansoura, Tanta, Zagazig and Damietta
rows.detail: Luxor, Aswan and Sharm el-Sheikh are not on Uber's own list. The airports it lists are Cairo, Hurghada, Sphinx (west of Cairo) and Borg El Arab (Alexandria).
rows.source: Uber: cities in Egypt

rows.label: Careem
rows.detail: We found no city list from Careem itself, and the lists in news reports and directories disagree about Luxor and Aswan. Open the app in the city before you count on it.
rows.source: Searched 17 Nov 2026: no city list on careem.com

rows.label: Uber and Careem in Cairo
rows.value: Drivers may ask for extra cash
rows.detail: In a 2025 forum thread, several travellers describe Cairo drivers asking for more money before the ride, or cancelling in the app so they could be paid in cash. You do not have to agree: you can decline and book another car.
rows.source: One Mile at a Time forum: Uber fares in Cairo (August 2025 replies)

rows.label: Fares for foreign visitors
rows.detail: Since December 2022, visitors who are not Egyptian pay foreigner fares, in US dollars or euros. The railway's own website and app sell tickets only to Egyptian citizens.
rows.source: Seat61: Train travel in Egypt (updated 14 Sep 2026)

rows.label: Where to buy
rows.value: At the station, or through an agency
rows.detail: In Cairo, the Arab and Foreign Reservation Office upstairs at Ramses station sells foreigner tickets for all trains and takes cards, with a 2.5% fee. Agencies can book ahead and deliver paper tickets to your hotel.
rows.source: Seat61: Train travel in Egypt (updated 14 Sep 2026)

rows.label: Sleeper trains to Luxor and Aswan
rows.value: Leave from Cairo Upper Egypt (Bashtil) station
rows.detail: The station opened in October 2024, about 7 km west of Ramses. The sleepers no longer leave from Ramses.
rows.source: Seat61: Train travel in Egypt (updated 14 Sep 2026)

rows.label: Aswan to Abu Simbel
rows.detail: A daily bus leaves Aswan at 08:00 and arrives at 12:00; the return leaves at 13:00 and reaches Aswan at 16:00. Most day tours leave Aswan very early, for example at 04:00.
rows.source: Seat61: Train travel in Egypt (updated 14 Sep 2026)
